info.name: PhysioGuide API
info.description:
Complete PhysioGuide backend collection, one folder per controller.

How to use:
1. Start the API (`dotnet run` in `gysi-proj/graduatio project`) and let it migrate/seed.
2. Set `baseUrl` if the API is not on http://localhost:5222.
3. Run the Auth folder first: login requests save patientToken, centerToken, therapistToken and adminToken.
4. Run folders in order. IDs are captured from responses; defaults point at seeded rows.
5. Upload requests need a real image selected in their form-data body.

Expected statuses are asserted per request. 400/404/409 are accepted where the outcome depends on seed data or on a record created earlier in the run.
Destructive admin requests only target throwaway records created by this collection (fallback ids 999999 produce 404).
